title: Sign-in preview
description: The result of signing in through the page your users see.
successMessage: The sign-in page worked and the login finished successfully. No tokens were requested — this is a preview, so the authorization code was discarded.
rejectedMessage: The sign-in page reported that the request was cancelled or refused.
stateMismatchMessage: This response does not match the request that started the preview, so it was discarded. Start the preview again from the dashboard.
noCodeMessage: The sign-in page came back without an authorization code, so the login did not finish.
closeHint: You can close this tab and return to the dashboard.
